title: A part's core turns untracked and tracked together with the part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test with 2 in its bin and a Core Charge of $25.00, so it has a core.
  • Make sure the Search box in the top bar is the global search, which lists inventory parts.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click the Search box in the top bar.
  5. Type Core for followed by part A's description.
  6. Press Escape.
  7. Click the part A row.
  8. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  9. Click Save.
  10. Click the Search box in the top bar.
  11. Type Core for followed by part A's description again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch on.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off.

Step 3:

  • Part A reads "Not Tracked" in Total Qty, and its Core column still reads $25.00.

Step 4:

  • The global search opens.

Step 5:

  • The result for part A's core shows "Not Tracked" in place of its available badge: it changed with the same save as part A, and you did not edit the core.

Step 6:

  • The global search closes.

Step 7:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch off.

Step 8:

  • The switch turns on.

Step 9:

  • Part A shows a quantity again in Total Qty.

Step 10:

  • The global search opens.

Step 11:

  • The result for part A's core shows an available badge again (a number, not "Not Tracked"), changed by the same save that turned part A back on.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part), story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S5-R9: “The part's core is tracked or untracked together with the part, in the same save. A core added to the part later, or in the same save, takes the part's tracking state.”
  • S9-R20: “Global search shows "Not Tracked" for an untracked part, in place of its "{n} available" badge.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “A core always has the same active state and the same tracking state as the part it belongs to.”
  • Key Decisions: “A core follows its part. A core is never activated, deactivated, tracked or untracked on its own.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
